slides.title: Web Crawler Overview
content: A web crawler is a system that automatically discovers and downloads web pages
Traverses web pages using hyperlinks starting from seed URLs
Works like a bot or spider in distributed systems
Used by search engines and data mining systems
Treats the web as a directed graph of pages and links

slides.title: Core Concepts
content: Web is modeled as a directed graph with pages as nodes
Links between pages act as edges
Seed URLs are starting points for crawling
Crawl budget limits resources used per website
System must handle scale, duplicates, and failures

slides.title: BFS Traversal
content: Web crawlers use breadth-first search traversal
Provides better coverage of web pages
Avoids deep traversal issues seen in DFS

slides.title: URL Frontier
content: URL frontier manages URLs to be crawled
Maintains queues for scheduling and prioritization
Separates URLs into downloaded and pending
Uses priority queues and host-based queues

slides.title: Politeness Policy
content: Allows only one active worker per host

slides.title: Robots.txt Handling
content: Robots.txt defines crawling rules for websites
Located at root path of domain

slides.title: HTML Downloader
content: Fetches web pages using HTTP or HTTPS

slides.title: Duplicate Detection
content: Identifies duplicate web pages using hashing
Uses hash functions like MD5 or SHA

slides.title: Spider Trap Handling
content: Spider traps create infinite crawling loops
Examples include dynamic URLs and calendars

slides.title: Data Noise Filtering
content: Improves data quality and storage efficiency

slides.title: Caching and Performance
content: Uses DNS caching to reduce lookup time
Applies short timeouts for faster response

slides.title: System Robustness
content: Uses retry mechanisms for failed requests
Uses consistent hashing for load distribution

slides.title: System Extensibility
content: Allows addition of new features easily

slides.title: Key Terminologies
content: Hash is a fingerprint of data content
Collision occurs when two inputs produce same hash
Politeness controls request rate per host
Traversal is process of visiting graph nodes

slides.title: Final Summary
content: Web crawler is a distributed system for discovering web pages
Uses BFS traversal and URL frontier for scheduling
Ensures politeness, duplicate detection, and filtering
